evals.prompt: Use agent-browser and Remotion to record https://todomvc.com/examples/react/dist/. Add three tasks, rename one, complete one, use Active and Completed, then clear completed tasks. Deliver a real MP4 with instructions.
evals.expected_output: Verified native-cursor recording and rendered 1080p/30fps MP4, editable project, chapter and click sheets; at most two rehearsals.
assertions: Native source and final output are 30 fps

evals.prompt: Record the local Project workspace using credentials from the supplied env file. Name a project Launch and save it. Exclude login footage, save auth state privately, and verify it can be reused.
evals.expected_output: Successful authenticated recording, passing saved-state reuse and no credentials in delivered artifacts.
assertions: Env-file form login succeeds before recording
Saved state opens the authenticated app in a fresh session
Credentials are absent from output JSON
Final MP4 fully decodes and excludes login

evals.prompt: Record opening a workspace. If several Open workspace buttons match, ask which one. I choose Team. Keep the same session and resume from that checkpoint.
evals.expected_output: A needs-human checkpoint before any ambiguous click; explicit resolution; two synchronized segments joined without human waiting or duplicated actions.
assertions: Ambiguous target pauses before any click
Resolution explicitly identifies the Team control
Resume keeps the original tab and completed steps
Two synchronized segments exclude the human wait
